# Change request 24 for the notes app

The app in this directory already implements the notes app. Everything it does today must keep working, with and
without JavaScript, unless this request changes it. Change the following.

## Read-only accounts
- The admin can make another user's account read-only, and writable again. The table on `/admin` gets a third
  column with the header cell `Access`; in each row that cell starts with the text `writable` or `read-only`.
  The row of every user other than `admin` also has a button `Make <name> read-only` (for a writable account) or
  `Make <name> writable` (for a read-only one). The `admin` row has neither button.
- Only the admin can change this: the **server** refuses it for anyone else.
- While an account is read-only, its user can still sign in and out, read and search their notes, use `Load more`,
  open note pages, export, and delete their account. The **server** refuses every other change to their notes:
  adding, editing (on the list page and on the note page), deleting, `Delete selected`, `Undo`, pinning,
  archiving, `Archive selected`, restoring, sharing and unsharing. Nothing changes, and the page the user ends up
  on shows `Your account is read-only` in an element with `role="alert"`.
- The list page of a read-only user shows the text `Read-only account`.
- It affects no one else: notes the user shared stay visible to the users they were shared with, and the user still
  sees the notes shared with them.
- The setting is kept on the server and survives signing out and in. Deleting the account ends it: the same name
  signing in again starts writable.
- Making an account read-only or writable also works with JavaScript disabled.

## 完成摘要

我已實作 `change.md` 要求的唯讀帳號功能。`nuxt typecheck` 與 `nuxt build` 都通過，伺服器上的端對端測試全部符合預期。測試用的伺服器已依 PID 停止，port 4833 也確認已釋放。

### 修改內容

| 範圍 | 檔案 | 內容 |
|---|---|---|
| **資料層** | `server/utils/store.ts` | 新增記錄唯讀使用者的集合，以及共用的拒絕函式 `refuseReadOnly()`。沒有 JS 時轉址並帶 `?error=read-only`；有 JS 時回傳 403，錯誤代碼為 `read-only`。刪除帳號時會一併清除唯讀狀態 |
| **管理員 API** | `server/api/admin/access.post.ts`（新增） | 只有 admin 能切換，其他人會被伺服器拒絕（403）。admin 帳號本身不能設為唯讀，不存在的使用者回傳 404 |
| **變更類 API** | 新增、編輯、儲存、刪除、批次、復原、置頂、封存、還原、分享、取消分享，共 11 支 | 一開始就先檢查唯讀狀態。清單頁編輯的 `Cancel` 不算變更，所以照常放行 |
| **`/admin`** | `app/pages/admin.vue` | 表格新增 `Access` 欄。除了 admin 那一列，每列都有 `Make <name> read-only` 或 `Make <name> writable` 按鈕，用一般表單送出，沒有 JS 也能用 |
| **清單頁** | `app/pages/notes/index.vue` | 唯讀帳號會顯示 `Read-only account`。遭拒的操作會在 `role="alert"` 元素中顯示 `Your account is read-only`，有沒有 JS 都一樣 |
| **單篇筆記頁／封存頁** | `[number].vue`、`archive.vue` | 儲存或還原被拒時，同樣顯示上述 alert |

### 驗證結果
- 唯讀帳號在無 JS 下送出的 13 種表單，全部被拒並轉址到正確頁面。JS 請求則收到 403。
- 讀取、匯出、登出再登入都正常，而且登出再登入後仍是唯讀。
- 改回可寫入後，新增筆記恢復正常。
- 刪除帳號後，用同名重新登入是可寫入狀態。

### 已知限制
- 唯讀帳號的頁面上，各個變更按鈕仍然顯示。這是刻意的：按下後由伺服器拒絕並顯示提示，符合規格所說「使用者最後看到的頁面要顯示提示」。
- 我沒有用真實瀏覽器（例如 Playwright）測過有 JS 時的互動流程，只靠型別檢查和程式碼審查確認。
- 跟原本的應用程式一樣，資料只存在記憶體，伺服器重啟後唯讀設定就會消失。

### 下一步建議
1. **用瀏覽器實測有 JS 的流程**：以 admin 把 ada 設為唯讀，再以 ada 身分試按 Delete、Pin、Share、Save，確認提示有出現。
2. **決定是否隱藏按鈕**：如果希望唯讀使用者一開始就看不到變更按鈕，可以依 `data.readOnly` 隱藏或停用它們，但要先確認這不違反規格的預期行為。
3. **提交變更**：確認沒問題後，可以照先前的慣例 commit 成 `step 24`。

bash -c '
B=http://localhost:4833; F="Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded"
for u in "/api/notes title=X" "/api/notes/n1/delete x=1" "/api/notes/n1/pin pinned=true" "/api/notes/n1/archive x=1" "/api/notes/n1/edit title=Y" "/api/notes/n1/edit action=cancel" "/api/notes/bulk action=delete&ids=n1" "/api/notes/bulk action=archive&ids=n1" "/api/notes/undo x=1" "/api/notes/n1/share name=bob" "/api/notes/n1/unshare name=bob" "/api/notes/n1/save title=Z" "/api/notes/n1/restore x=1"; do set -- $u; curl -s -b d.txt -H "$F" -d "$2" $B$1 -o /dev/null -w "$1 $2 %{http_code} %{redirect_url}\n"; done
curl -s -b d.txt $B/api/notes | head -c 200; echo
curl -s -b d.txt $B/api/export -o /dev/null -w "export %{http_code}\n"
# logout/in keeps
curl -s -b d.txt -H "$F" -d x=1 $B/api/logout -o /dev/null; curl -s -c d.txt -H "$F" -d name=Ada $B/api/login -o /dev/null
curl -s -b d.txt $B/api/notes | grep -o "\"readOnly\":[a-z]*"
# writable again
curl -s -b a.txt -H "$F" -d "name=ada&readOnly=false" $B/api/admin/access -o /dev/null
curl -s -b d.txt -H "$F" -d title=New $B/api/notes -o /dev/null -w "add after writable %{http_code} %{redirect_url}\n"
# delete account resets
curl -s -b a.txt -H "$F" -d "name=carl&readOnly=true" $B/api/admin/access -o /dev/null
curl -s -b c.txt -H "$F" -d x=1 $B/api/account/delete -o /dev/null
curl -s -c c.txt -H "$F" -d name=carl $B/api/login -o /dev/null
curl -s -b c.txt $B/api/notes | grep -o "\"readOnly\":[a-z]*"
'; kill $(cat /tmp/srv.pid); rm -f a.txt c.txt d.txt; git status --short
